parts:
but the theoretical and the experimental difficulties do not match at all

mirt uses a slope and intercept form, not the classical "difficulty" parameters. If you want the difficulties use coef(mod, IRTpars = TRUE). Also, search through the forum emails because this is talked about often. Cheers.

Phil
